credit.heading: Pay later
credit.intro: Pay for this order later through our NBFC partner, {lender}. The lender pays your escrow now and you repay the lender by the due date. The lender is the lender of record; cnote does not lend its own money.
credit.consentLabel: I agree that cnote may use my GST verification, escrow order history, dispute record and trust score to compute a credit score, and share the score with a few summary figures (not my GST returns) with {lender} for this application.
credit.noAuto: Nothing is charged until you accept an offer.
credit.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

status.submitted: Waiting for the lender to respond.
status.accepted: Offer accepted. The lender will pay your escrow once the loan is disbursed.
status.disbursed: Loan disbursed. The lender pays your escrow, and you repay the lender by the due date.
status.rejected: The lender did not approve this request. You can still pay through the normal escrow payment above.
status.failed: The request could not be submitted. Please try again later.

kfs.heading: Key Fact Statement
kfs.intro: Read this before you accept. It is provided by the lender, {lender}.
kfs.allInApr: Total cost of credit including fees (per year)
kfs.lateFeeValue: {percent} per month on the overdue amount
kfs.coolingOffValue: {days} days after disbursal. You can exit by repaying the amount and interest for the days you used, with no penalty.
kfs.repayment_buyer_instalment: By you, to the lender, by the due date.

accept.acknowledge: I have read the Key Fact Statement and agree to take this loan from {lender}.
